Office Document AI Assistant for SMEs

After AI training, the same clients need private templates and document workflows: quotation, meeting summary, HR letter, client reply, report draft.

Why this can work

Target accountants, legal offices, exporters, agencies, school admins, clinics, and SMEs that process repeated letters, quotations, reports, and summaries.

Staff rewrite similar documents again and again, and generic AI output does not follow company format.

Your office documents follow your own format and take minutes, not hours.

Validation signals

  • AI training creates the entry point.
  • Document repetition is common in offices.
  • SMEs can pay more for time savings.
  • Templates create retention.

MVP modules

  • Company template library
  • Document generator
  • Meeting summary prompt
  • Quotation draft
  • HR letter draft
  • Approval checklist
  • Usage log

Do not build first

  • Do not train on confidential data without consent.
  • Do not promise legal accuracy.
  • Do not build a general chatbot.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Data privacy.
  • Wrong output.
  • Tool fatigue.
Mitigations
  • Human approval required.
  • Use safe templates.
  • Start with 3 workflows.
